description: This file contains the implementation of the TransactionAgent class, which manages distributed transactions including starting, resolving, committing, and aborting transactions within the Orleans framework. It includes detailed logging, error handling, and participant management for transactional consistency.

classes.name: TransactionAgent
classes.description: A class responsible for managing distributed transactions, including starting, resolving, committing, and aborting transactions, with detailed logging and participant coordination.

methods.name: StartTransaction
methods.description: Initiates a new transaction, checking for overload conditions, generating a transaction ID, and logging the start.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a transaction by committing or aborting based on participant responses, with error handling and statistics tracking.

methods.name: CommitReadOnlyTransaction
methods.description: Handles the commit process for read-only transactions, including sending commit requests, handling responses, and aborting on failure.

methods.name: CommitReadWriteTransaction
methods.description: Handles the commit process for read-write transactions, including prepare, commit, and abort procedures with participant notifications.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts a transaction by notifying all participants to release locks and roll back updates.

methods.name: CollateParticipants
methods.description: Organizes transaction participants into categories such as writers, resources, and managers based on their roles and properties.
